verses.ar:
أَعُوذُ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
verses.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
Truly We have granted you a clear victory. (48:1)

verses.ar: لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللّٰهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُسْتَقِيمًا
verses.tr: Li-yaghfira laka-Llāhu mā taqaddama min dhanbika wa mā ta'akhkhara wa yutimma niʿmatahu ʿalayka wa yahdiyaka ṣirāṭan mustaqīmā
verses.en: So that Allah may forgive you what came before and what is to come, complete His favor upon you, and guide you on a straight path. (48:2)
And that Allah may aid you with a mighty victory. (48:3)

verses.ar: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ
verses.tr: Laqad jā'akum rasūlun min anfusikum ʿazīzun ʿalayhi mā ʿanittum ḥarīṣun ʿalaykum bi-l-mu'minīna ra'ūfun raḥīm
verses.en: There has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves; your suffering weighs heavily upon him; he is deeply concerned for you, and to the believers he is kind and merciful. (9:128)

verses.ar: فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
verses.tr: Fa-in tawallaw fa-qul ḥasbiya-Llāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbu-l-ʿarshi-l-ʿaẓīm
verses.en: But if they turn away, say: Allah is enough for me; there is no god but Him; in Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the Tremendous Throne. (9:129)

verses.ar: إِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
verses.tr: Inna-Llāha wa malā'ikatahu yuṣallūna ʿalā-n-Nabiyy, yā ayyuhā-lladhīna āmanū ṣallū ʿalayhi wa sallimū taslīmā
verses.en: Truly Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and greet him abundantly with peace. (33:56)
